I don't like whoring my own content much but I'd like to get this site started with something. I use some execution tricks that might not be widely known when running sword:

  • Hold the X/Square button with your index finger while running to the sword. This way you start picking up the sword on the first possible frame and don't have to slow down.
  • Press Y/Triangle near the end of the third slam. This buffers the input so that you drop the sword on the first possible frame to Blink Strike Crota as soon as possible.

Also take note of where our Defender put up his bubble. I would have died on my way back from Crota if not for that overshield.
